name: elagoht/htmlcheck
description: A collage plugin that checks the HTML a site renders and reports what it finds as warnings and errors.

config.description: A collage plugin that checks the HTML a site renders and reports what it finds as warnings and errors.

descriptionMax.description: DescriptionMax is the length, in characters, past which a search engine cuts a meta description short. Default 160; a negative value is an error.

ignoreLinks.description: IgnoreLinks are path prefixes "broken-link" does not check: a route served by a handler of your own, an API. A prefix matches at a segment boundary, with or without its trailing slash: "/api" and "/api/" both ignore /api and /api/v1, and neither /apiary.

pageBudget.description: PageBudget is the size in bytes past which a page is reported by "page-size". Zero leaves the rule silent; a negative value is an error.

rules.description: Rules changes rules' levels, by name. A rule not named keeps its default; see Rules() for every rule and its default.

titleMax.description: TitleMax is the length, in characters, past which a search engine cuts a title short. Default 60; a negative value is an error.
